title: GenAI for Career Impact — Certificate Program
tagline: Go from AI-curious to AI-capable: prompt, create, automate, build and launch — responsibly.
audience: Non-technical undergraduate students (B.Com, BBA, BA, B.Sc) in affiliated colleges. No coding required.
language: English, with bilingual (Kannada / Hindi) prompt examples
weeklyCommitment: ≈ 6 hours: 2 h guided session · 2 h self-study · 2 h lab / project
prerequisites: Comfortable using a smartphone or laptop and a web browser
A Google account (for Gemini, NotebookLM, Sheets and AppSheet free tiers)
Basic English reading; Kannada / Hindi speakers are supported throughout
No programming, statistics or design background needed
outcomes: Explain in plain language how generative AI works, what it can and cannot do, and choose an appropriate tool for a given task.
Design, evaluate and refine prompts for text, image, video and audio generation to a professional standard.
Produce a multi-format content portfolio — documents, visuals, video and audio — that meets brand, accessibility and ethical standards.
Build custom AI assistants and no-code automations that solve a real business or campus problem.
Ship and validate a minimum viable AI product using no-code tools, with users and evidence.
Apply responsible-AI principles — fairness, transparency, privacy, security and governance — including India's DPDP framework.
Use AI to accelerate career readiness: resume, LinkedIn presence, professional writing and interview performance.

conditions: At least 4 of 5 Project Blocks submitted
Attendance / activity ≥ 75% of guided sessions (instructor-led batches)

components.name: Lesson quizzes
components.description: Every lesson ends with a short quiz. Best attempt counts; the average across all lessons is scaled to 15 marks.

components.name: Project Blocks 1–5
components.description: Five applied projects (7 marks each), graded on the rubric in assessments/rubrics.md.

components.name: Capstone: AI product + pitch
components.description: Working no-code AI product, evidence of user validation, 5-minute pitch and a 2-page report.

components.name: Final assessment
components.description: 60 MCQs (60 min) drawn from the lesson quiz bank plus two scenario responses (30 min).

components.name: Reflection journal
components.description: One short reflection per module (8 entries) using the prompts at the end of each lesson.

toolkit.note: Free tiers are enough for the whole course. Use whichever is available; the skills transfer.

modules.title: AI Foundations & the Future of Work
modules.summary: What generative AI actually is, why it matters for your career right now, which tools exist, and how to use them responsibly from day one.
outcomes: Describe how GenAI is changing entry-level roles in commerce, management, arts and science careers
Distinguish AI, machine learning, deep learning and generative AI with everyday analogies
Set up a personal AI toolkit using free tiers and explain the trade-offs between tools
Apply the Automate / Augment / Avoid framework to your own weekly tasks

topics.title: Why GenAI is rewriting careers
topics.summary: The career transformation underway, what it means for a non-technical graduate in India, and the mindset of an AI-augmented professional.

topics.title: AI, ML, deep learning & GenAI — what is actually different
topics.summary: Types of AI, how a language model predicts the next token, why it can be brilliant and wrong at the same time.

topics.title: The GenAI ecosystem: tools, tiers & your starter toolkit
topics.summary: Map the landscape — chat, image, video, audio, automation — and set up the free accounts you will use for ten weeks.

topics.title: Capabilities, limits & responsible use
topics.summary: Hallucination, bias, privacy and academic integrity, plus the Automate / Augment / Avoid framework for deciding what AI should touch.

modules.title: Prompt Engineering & Conversational AI
modules.summary: The core skill of the course: getting reliable, professional-quality work out of chat assistants — and knowing when the output is wrong.
outcomes: Structure prompts with RTF for quick tasks and CO-STAR for professional deliverables
Use few-shot examples, step-by-step reasoning, self-critique and prompt chaining to improve output quality
Adapt prompting to accounting, marketing, HR, research writing and data-analysis tasks
Run a research workflow with citations you have actually verified
Evaluate outputs against a rubric and maintain a personal prompt library

topics.title: Working with chat assistants: getting real work done
topics.summary: Context windows, conversation hygiene, files and voice, and an honest comparison of the major assistants for student tasks.

topics.title: Prompt anatomy: RTF and CO-STAR
topics.summary: The building blocks of a good prompt, two frameworks you will use every day, and the iteration loop.

topics.title: Advanced prompting patterns
topics.summary: Few-shot, chain-of-thought, step-back, persona, self-critique, output templating and prompt chaining — with when-to-use guidance.

topics.title: Prompting for your discipline
topics.summary: Worked prompt sets for commerce, management, arts and science students, including bilingual Kannada–English prompting.

topics.title: Research & writing assistants
topics.summary: Perplexity, NotebookLM and deep-research modes; summarising papers; citing honestly and avoiding plagiarism.

topics.title: Evaluating & refining GenAI outputs
topics.summary: A fact-checking routine, rubric-based evaluation, A/B testing prompts and building your prompt library.

topics.title: Project Block 1 — Personal Prompt Playbook
topics.summary: Ten tested, reusable prompts for your discipline with evaluation notes and a one-page reflection.

modules.title: AI for Visual Content Creation
modules.summary: Images, designs, presentations and short videos — created, edited and repurposed with AI, to a standard a brand would accept.
outcomes: Explain how image generators work and choose the right tool for a brief
Write image prompts that control subject, style, composition and consistency; edit with inpainting and outpainting
Produce posters, social posts, presentations and infographics using AI-assisted design tools
Create a short video with text-to-video, avatar and editing tools, including captions
Repurpose one asset across formats while keeping brand consistency and respecting copyright

topics.title: The visual content revolution & how image generators work
topics.summary: Why visual content matters for every career, an intuition for diffusion models, and the tool landscape.

topics.title: Image prompt mastery & editing
topics.summary: The prompt formula for images, style and composition vocabulary, iteration, and editing techniques.

topics.title: Design workflows: Canva, presentations & infographics
topics.summary: From generated image to finished design: brand kits, AI presentation builders and data-to-infographic.

topics.title: AI video: text-to-video, avatars & short-form
topics.summary: Script → storyboard → generate → edit → caption: a complete workflow for a 30–60 second video.

topics.title: Repurposing, brand consistency & visual ethics
topics.summary: One idea, ten formats; brand rules; copyright, deepfakes, disclosure and content credentials.

topics.title: Project Block 2 — Campaign Kit
topics.summary: A poster, three social posts and a 30-second video for a college event or a local business, with a brand sheet.

modules.title: AI for Audio, Voice & Music
modules.summary: Voice generation, editing, music and voice cloning — and how audio fits into a modern content stack, in more than one language.
outcomes: Identify audio content opportunities in education, business and creator careers
Generate natural multilingual speech and select the right voice for a purpose
Clean up recordings, generate background music and understand voice cloning and its consent requirements
Turn written content into a podcast, voiceover or accessible audio version

topics.title: Audio opportunities & voice generation
topics.summary: Where audio is growing, how text-to-speech works, choosing voices, and Kannada / Hindi / Tamil generation.

topics.title: Editing, music generation & voice cloning
topics.summary: Text-based audio editing, noise removal, AI music for background scores, and voice cloning done ethically.

topics.title: Audio in your content stack
topics.summary: Blog → podcast, lecture → audio notes, video voiceovers, IVR scripts and accessibility.

topics.title: Project Block 3 — Bilingual Audio Episode
topics.summary: A 3-minute explainer podcast or voiceover in English plus one Indian language, with music and show notes.

modules.title: Custom Assistants & No-Code Automation
modules.summary: Move from using AI to building with it: purpose-built assistants, retrieval over your own documents, and automations that run while you sleep.
outcomes: Build a custom assistant (GPT / Gem / Project) with instructions, knowledge files and guardrails
Explain retrieval-augmented generation without code and know where it fails
Create multi-step automations with triggers, AI steps and human checkpoints in Zapier, Make or n8n
Map a business process and identify automation candidates with a simple ROI estimate
Build a working no-code app with an AI feature

topics.title: Custom GPTs, Gems & Projects: purpose-built assistants
topics.summary: Instructions, knowledge, conversation starters and guardrails; building a study buddy and a placement coach.

topics.title: Giving AI your knowledge: RAG without code
topics.summary: Why assistants need your documents, how retrieval works, NotebookLM as a RAG lab, and its limits.

topics.title: Low-code automation with AI steps
topics.summary: Triggers, actions, filters and AI steps in Zapier, Make and n8n; Sheets + AI; three starter automations.

topics.title: Business process design: finding what to automate
topics.summary: Process mapping, the automation scorecard, ROI in minutes saved, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

topics.title: Building a no-code AI app: idea to working MVP
topics.summary: Choosing a builder, designing data and screens, adding an AI feature, and testing with real users.

topics.title: Project Block 4 — Automation or Mini-App
topics.summary: A working automation or mini-app that solves a real college or small-business problem, with a demo video.

modules.title: AI Product Sprint (Capstone)
modules.summary: Take one idea from concept to launch: validate it, build it with no-code tools, integrate AI, test it with users and pitch it.
outcomes: Write a problem statement and validate it with interviews and AI-assisted market research
Build an MVP that combines a no-code app, an AI feature and a data model
Run a go-live checklist covering testing, privacy, error handling and cost
Collect user insights, define metrics and present a credible growth plan

topics.title: Product concept & market validation
topics.summary: Problem framing, user interviews, competitor scans with AI, and a one-page lean canvas.

topics.title: Build sprint: app, AI feature & data
topics.summary: Scoping the MVP, building screens and data, wiring the AI feature, and keeping a build log.

topics.title: Integration, testing, privacy & go-live
topics.summary: Connecting automations, test plans, privacy notices, failure handling and the launch checklist.

topics.title: User insights, growth planning & the pitch
topics.summary: Feedback loops, simple analytics, iteration priorities and a 5-minute pitch built with AI.

topics.title: Capstone — AI Product Demo Day
topics.summary: Working product, evidence of user validation, 5-minute pitch and a 2-page report.

modules.title: Responsible AI: Ethics, Fairness, Security & Governance
modules.summary: The judgement employers are asking for: spotting bias, demanding transparency, protecting data and following the rules — in India and globally.
outcomes: Apply the principles of fairness, accountability, transparency and privacy to real cases
Test an AI system for bias and propose mitigations
Read a model card or system card and explain a model's limits to a non-expert
Recognise prompt injection, data leakage and shadow-AI risks; summarise DPDP and EU AI Act obligations that matter to a workplace

topics.title: AI ethics principles & real-world failures
topics.summary: FATE principles through case studies in hiring, lending, policing, exam proctoring and content moderation.

topics.title: Detecting and reducing bias — hands-on
topics.summary: Where bias enters, a bias-testing protocol for chatbots and image generators, and fairness metrics intuition.

topics.title: Explainability, model cards & transparency
topics.summary: Why black boxes are a business risk, intuition for LIME and SHAP, and how to read a model or system card.

topics.title: Security, privacy law & AI governance
topics.summary: Prompt injection, data leakage, shadow AI, India's DPDP Act and Rules, the EU AI Act, and writing a team AI policy.

topics.title: Project Block 5 — AI Ethics Audit
topics.summary: Audit one AI tool you used in this course against a fairness, transparency, privacy and safety checklist.

modules.title: AI-Powered Career Launch
modules.summary: Convert ten weeks of work into a job search advantage: resume, portfolio, LinkedIn, professional writing and interview practice — all AI-assisted, all authentically yours.
outcomes: Produce an ATS-friendly resume and a portfolio that showcases course projects
Optimise a LinkedIn profile and plan a month of professional content
Write clear business emails, reports and proposals with AI as an editor, not a ghostwriter
Practise interviews and group discussions with AI feedback and map AI-augmented roles for your degree

topics.title: Resume & portfolio building with AI
topics.summary: ATS rules, achievement statements, tailoring to a job description, and turning course projects into a portfolio.

topics.title: LinkedIn & your professional brand
topics.summary: Headline, About, featured projects, a 4-week content plan and outreach messages that get replies.

topics.title: Professional writing & email with AI
topics.summary: Emails, reports, proposals and minutes; tone for Indian workplaces; editing prompts that keep your voice.

topics.title: Interview & communication practice; the AI-era job map
topics.summary: Mock interviews with AI, STAR stories, GD practice, presentation feedback, and roles for commerce, arts and science graduates.
